title: ABOUT | Matrix Massage & Bodywork

mainEntity.name: Who owns Matrix Massage in Salem, WI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matrix Massage is independently owned by a licensed massage therapist dedicated to personalized, science-based care. The business is rooted in local wellness and client-centered service.
Yes, Matrix Massage is a woman-owned, locally operated wellness clinic based in Salem, Wisconsin, offering customized massage and holistic therapy services to the community.
Matrix Massage combines therapeutic bodywork with science-backed wellness technologies like red light therapy, lymphatic drainage, and magnesium protocols in a calming, results-driven environment.

mainEntity.name: Do the therapists have advanced training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, therapists at Matrix Massage have advanced training in multiple modalities including manual lymphatic drainage, muscle scraping, cupping, and red light therapy applications.
Matrix Massage is located at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. The clinic is easily accessible from surrounding areas including Kenosha and Pleasant Prairie.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve clients from Pleasant Prairie, Kenosha, and Antioch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we regularly welcome clients from Pleasant Prairie, Kenosha, and Antioch, IL seeking therapeutic massage and integrative wellness services.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a massage with Matrix Massage in Salem, WI?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book online by visiting www.massagebook.com/me/danelle-borglin or text 262-939-9325 to request an appointment. We offer flexible scheduling for new and returning clients.
